description: Strummed acoustic guitar preset. Presence-forward EQ plus gentle tube warmth. Spreads L/R when colliding with keys at center.
name: guitar-strum
notes: Precondition: Guitar track selected in Cubase, inserts 0-1 loaded per opencode/reference/guitar-strum.md.
Send in listed order with unique numeric id per request to POST http://localhost:3001/rpc.
Response param field shows resolved Cubase title; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling.
Harsh-overtone cut / low-cut / air shelf are manual by resolved title (same-slot duplicate Gain would overwrite).
Send slot 0 -> room FX via send.set (assign destination in Cubase one-time setup). Slot 1 free for delay throws.
